title: Convex Countour
statementMd:
You are given an strictly convex polygon with $*n*$ vertices. It is guaranteed that no three points are collinear. You would like to take a maximum non intersecting path on the polygon vertices that visits each point at most once.

More specifically your path can be represented as some sequence of distinct polygon vertices. Your path is the straight line segments between adjacent vertices in order. These segments are not allowed to touch or intersect each other except at the vertices in your sequence.

Given the polygon, print the maximum length non-intersecting path that visits each point at most once.

## Input

The first line of input will contain a single integer $*n*$ ($2 ≤ *n* ≤ 2 500$), the number of points.

The next $*n*$ lines will contain two integers $*x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*}$ ($|*x*_{*i*}|, |*y*_{*i*}| ≤ 10^{9}$), denoting the coordinates of the $*i*$-th vertex.

It is guaranteed that these points are listed in clockwise order.

## Output

Print a single floating point number, representing the longest non-intersecting path that visits the vertices at most once.

Your answer will be accepted if it has absolute or relative error at most $10^{ - 9}$. More specifically, if your answer is $*a*$ and the jury answer is $*b*$, your answer will be accepted if ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c5e2d5f952bf0600d65151cbd23c801f49c2c594.png).

## Note

One optimal path is to visit points 0,1,3,2 in order.
statementZhMd:
给定一个具有 $*n*$ 个顶点的严格凸多边形。保证不存在三个点共线。现在希望在多边形的顶点上选取一条最长的不相交路径，使得每个点至多被访问一次。

更具体地说，你的路径可以表示为一系列互不相同的多边形顶点。路径由按照顺序排列的相邻顶点之间的直线段组成。除序列中的顶点外，这些线段之间不允许相互接触或相交。

给定该多边形，请输出访问每个点至多一次的不相交路径的最大长度。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$2 ≤ *n* ≤ 2 500$），表示点的数量。

接下来的 $*n*$ 行中，每行包含两个整数 $*x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*}$（$|*x*_{*i*}|, |*y*_{*i*}| ≤ 10^{9}$），表示第 $*i*$ 个顶点的坐标。

保证这些点按照顺时针顺序给出。

## 输出格式

输出一个浮点数，表示访问每个顶点至多一次的不相交路径的最大长度。

当绝对误差或相对误差不超过 $10^{ - 9}$ 时，你的答案将被接受。更具体地说，如果你的答案为 $*a*$，评测答案为 $*b*$，则当 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c5e2d5f952bf0600d65151cbd23c801f49c2c594.png) 时，你的答案将被接受。

## 说明

一种最优路径是依次访问点 0、1、3、2。
